subject: Post-call recap: SendWell cost targets, model routing, and pilot next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@sendwell.com>; integrations@sendwell.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SendWell cost targets, model routing, and pilot next steps

Hi Elena — great to meet this morning. Quick recap + two asks so we can size a clean pilot: 

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use: customer support automation (triage + short replies) + contextual search for KB (embeddings).
- Expected steady-state volumes: you estimated ~20M user messages/month (peak 1.5x). Average user message length ~60 tokens.
- Embeddings: roughly 500k vector generations/month for search indexing and similarity lookups.
- Rerank: ~150k calls/month on top of search results.
- Latency target: p95 sub-500ms for chat flows; embeddings can tolerate higher latency.

Two asks to finalize our costing: 
1) Can you confirm the monthly budget range for hosting inference (approx $/month)? You mentioned a ballpark last call — helpful to have a numeric range.
2) Any internal preference on model quality vs unit-cost tradeoff? (e.g., prioritize lower cost models if we can compensate with prompt engineering and caching)

Preliminary note on pricing math (very rough):
- 20M messages * 60 tokens = 1.2B tokens/month for chat.
- Embeddings (500k) and rerank (150k) add some cost but are orders of magnitude smaller in token consumption.
- We typically express negotiation as target $/1M tokens for chat workloads; caching + batching can reduce that effective rate.

If you confirm budget range and any model-quality preference, I’ll send a short model-mix recommendation with the corresponding $/1M targets and a mutual action plan for a 2–4 week pilot.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your quick numbers and then send the pricing sketch.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — great summary. Confirming numbers below; added a few clarifications: 

Confirmed volumes:
- User messages: ~20M/month (est). Peak factor ~1.5x monthly average.
- Avg tokens per message: ~60 tokens (we will send a sample distribution next week).
- Embeddings: ~500k vector generations/month (for new docs + reindex cadence).
- Rerank: ~150k calls/month.

Budget:
- Target monthly spend for inference: $7,000 — $12,000 (this is the range procurement will sign off on for pilot + initial months).
- Target unit aim: we’d like to see something at or under $9 / 1M tokens for the chat-heavy workload after any applicable pilot credits and optimizations.

Quality vs cost:
- Prefer a balanced approach: slightly favor cost (so long as quality remains high for customer-facing replies). If you have concrete model alternatives with expected ROUGE/semantic quality tradeoffs, please show them.

Other asks:
- Can you confirm if Redwood can apply prefix caching for common prompts we have (welcome flow + ticket triage)? That will materially reduce cost.
- Security questionnaire: procurement will send the filled questionnaire early next week; please confirm point-of-contact for evidence.

Thanks — we’re keen to move to a short pilot.

— Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@sendwell.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SendWell cost targets, model routing, and pilot next steps

Thanks Elena — perfect. Below is a concise pricing sketch and model-mix recommendation that aims at your $9 / 1M tokens target while meeting latency needs. I’ll attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) and our pricing calc in the next email. 

Quick assumptions (for the sketch):
- Chat tokens/month: 1.2B tokens (20M * 60).
- Embeddings and rerank token-equivalents treated separately (we price embeddings per vector and rerank per call).
- We assume sensible batching and prefix/KV caching on triage flows that reduce effective chat tokens by ~15% in steady state for common prompts.

Model-mix recommendation (pilot configuration):
- Chat: 70% of calls routed to a cost-optimized chat model (redwood-chat-cost-1) — expected base cost ~ $7.5 / 1M tokens before optimizations; with caching & batching we expect effective $/1M tokens in the $6.5–$8.5 range.
- High-quality Chat (fallback): 30% routed to redwood-chat-hq-1 for customer-critical replies (higher latency/cost). Use policy-based routing (A/B or canary) to limit spend.
- Embeddings: route to emb-lite-128 for bulk similarity (500k vectors/month) — pricing per vector in pilot is listed in attached calc.
- Rerank: small rerank model for 150k calls/month; priced per call (stubbed in calc).

Target unit economics (summary):
- Target blended chat $/1M tokens (with our pilot config + expected caching): ~$9 / 1M tokens (aligned with your ask).
- With tighter caching and a 60% cost-optimized routing we can drop effective rate toward $7 / 1M.

Operational asks for pilot:
- Send us one week of anonymized sample traffic (tokens distribution) so we can simulate real batching gains.
- Procurement to share the security questionnaire (Vanessa will be our compliance POC).
- Proposed pilot length: 2 weeks sandbox + 2 weeks production shadowing. 

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll upload the MAP and the pricing calculation CSV to the Drive and share the link.
2) Vanessa will follow up to schedule a kickoff and confirm compliance POCs.
3) Karthik will provision a trial cluster and temporary token allocation for the pilot.

If this looks OK, can we target a pilot kickoff next Monday, Apr 5?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
